source_semantics: Authenticated identity or set of identities receiving access
important_relations_or_lifecycle: bound to role on resource; human/workload types
semantic_risk: Principal is contextual and includes multiple implementation identity kinds

source_semantics: Set of principals selected by group or mapped attribute
important_relations_or_lifecycle: role binding grants same role to selected set
semantic_risk: Not necessarily a persistent social/access group object

source_semantics: Operation allowed on Google Cloud resource, often corresponds to API method
important_relations_or_lifecycle: included in role; checked during resource access
semantic_risk: Permission string is implementation-level action-resource capability

source_semantics: Named collection of permissions
important_relations_or_lifecycle: granted to principal on resource by policy binding
semantic_risk: Not UFO Role

source_semantics: Associates one role with one or more principals in allow policy attached to resource
important_relations_or_lifecycle: principal granted role over resource; may have condition; inherited through hierarchy
semantic_risk: Binding is not Permission and effective access includes inheritance/deny/PAB

source_semantics: Policy attached to resource containing role bindings
important_relations_or_lifecycle: governs access; inherited by descendants
semantic_risk: Policy attachment/hierarchy is implementation semantics

source_semantics: Policy prevents principals using specified permissions despite grants
important_relations_or_lifecycle: interacts with effective access computation
semantic_risk: Deny is not negative Permission instance alone

source_semantics: Defines resources principal is eligible to access even if role granted
important_relations_or_lifecycle: constrains effective resource universe
semantic_risk: Boundary policy is not AdministrativeDomain or Resource itself

source_semantics: Attribute-based condition on bindings/policies
important_relations_or_lifecycle: evaluated over resource/request/time attributes; role applies only when true
semantic_risk: Condition expression belongs policy layer not IdentityContext

source_semantics: Organization/folder/project/resource hierarchy drives policy inheritance
important_relations_or_lifecycle: child inherits ancestor policies; scope affects grant
semantic_risk: Do not turn cloud resource hierarchy into identity domain taxonomy

source_semantics: Represents non-human user/workload; is both a Google Cloud resource and IAM principal
important_relations_or_lifecycle: belongs to project; gets roles; can be impersonated; credentials/tokens used by workloads
cm4di_target: CM4DI-C3003 ServiceAccount; C0025 Principal; C0026 Resource context
semantic_risk: ServiceAccount is not Workload itself and dual principal/resource roles are contextual

source_semantics: Logical pool for external workforce identities
important_relations_or_lifecycle: contains providers; external subjects become Google principals; belongs to organization
semantic_risk: Pool is not IdentityContext and not a group of people

source_semantics: OIDC/SAML provider configuration maps external credential attributes to Google attributes
important_relations_or_lifecycle: belongs to pool; can be enabled/disabled; exchanges credentials/tokens
semantic_risk: Provider config is not external IdP entity itself

source_semantics: Maps external assertion claims to google.subject, groups and custom attributes
important_relations_or_lifecycle: determines principal identifiers and sets; used by policy bindings
semantic_risk: Mapping does not prove claim truth; source provenance remains external

source_semantics: Normalized subject value derived from upstream assertion and used in principal identifier/audit
important_relations_or_lifecycle: must be uniquely mappable to external identity per best practices
semantic_risk: Mapped subject is identifier/reference, not external entity equality

source_semantics: Pool for external workload identities independent of workforce pool
important_relations_or_lifecycle: contains providers; maps external credentials to workload principals
semantic_risk: Workload pool != workforce pool and != workload itself

source_semantics: External workload identity after token exchange/mapping can receive direct resource grants
important_relations_or_lifecycle: identified by principal/principalSet URI; accesses resource directly or impersonates service account
semantic_risk: Federated principal representation is not workload entity itself

source_semantics: Exchanges trusted external credential for federated Google token
important_relations_or_lifecycle: external credential -> STS token; may precede direct access or service account impersonation
semantic_risk: Token exchange is not Authentication/IdentityProofing by itself

source_semantics: Federated principal is granted permission to impersonate service account and obtain short-lived access token
important_relations_or_lifecycle: principal granted workloadIdentityUser/tokenCreator-like authority; calls credentials service
cm4di_target: CM4DI-C0030 Delegation; C3013 TemporaryCredential; C3003 ServiceAccount
semantic_risk: Impersonation does not mean identity equality

source_semantics: Short-lived token obtained after federation/impersonation
important_relations_or_lifecycle: issued after STS/credentials operation; expires; audit links delegation chain
semantic_risk: Used across workload contexts; module ownership deserves review

source_semantics: Provider has state/disabled/expire semantics; disabled provider cannot exchange new tokens while existing tokens remain valid
important_relations_or_lifecycle: enable/disable/expire affects future exchange not already-issued token validity
semantic_risk: Provider-state transition differs from session/token status

source_semantics: Principals request temporary auditable access with optional justification/approval
important_relations_or_lifecycle: request/approve/activate/expire privileged grant
semantic_risk: Potential PAM/IGA adjacency; not Core concept from one product
